    <script>
      // VIEW-STATE KEEPER — the app shell can reload this page at any
      // moment (a new build landing, memory pressure) and the visitor
      // must NEVER be dumped back at the homepage for it. There is no
      // reload code in this page and none is needed: the full view
      // state — page scroll offset, every expanded/collapsed section,
      // the cart contents, which sheet is open, the Ask panel — is
      // mirrored into
      // sessionStorage on every change, and ANY fresh load restores it
      // exactly. sessionStorage is scoped to this tab's session, so
      // the state dies with the session and never follows the visitor
      // anywhere else. The only way back to the top/home state is the
      // visitor's own navigation, which this keeper simply mirrors.
      (function () {
        var KEY = "sourccey-ck-view-v1";
        var cartGet = null, cartSet = null;
        var restoring = false;
        var userTouched = false;
        var SV = window.SV = {
          openSheet: null,
          registerCart: function (g, s) { cartGet = g; cartSet = s; }
        };
        try { if ("scrollRestoration" in history) history.scrollRestoration = "manual"; } catch (e) {}

        function read() {
          try { var raw = sessionStorage.getItem(KEY); return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null; }
          catch (e) { return null; }
        }
        function write(st) {
          try { sessionStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(st)); } catch (e) {}
        }

        // A toggle (any [aria-expanded] control) is keyed by its id,
        // else its aria-controls target, else its structural path —
        // stable across reloads because the markup is identical.
        function toggleKey(btn) {
          if (btn.id) return "id:" + btn.id;
          var ac = btn.getAttribute("aria-controls");
          if (ac) return "ac:" + ac;
          var path = [], n = btn;
          while (n && n !== document.body) {
            var p = n.parentNode; if (!p) break;
            var idx = 0, sib = n;
            while ((sib = sib.previousElementSibling)) { if (sib.tagName === n.tagName) idx++; }
            path.unshift(n.tagName.toLowerCase() + ":" + idx);
            n = p;
          }
          return "path:" + path.join("/");
        }
        function findToggle(key) {
          if (key.indexOf("id:") === 0) return document.getElementById(key.slice(3));
          if (key.indexOf("ac:") === 0) return document.querySelector('[aria-controls="' + key.slice(3) + '"]');
          if (key.indexOf("path:") === 0) {
            var parts = key.slice(5).split("/"), n = document.body;
            for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
              var seg = parts[i].split(":"), tag = seg[0].toUpperCase(), idx = parseInt(seg[1], 10), found = null, c = 0;
              for (var j = 0; j < n.children.length; j++) {
                if (n.children[j].tagName === tag) { if (c === idx) { found = n.children[j]; break; } c++; }
              }
              if (!found) return null;
              n = found;
            }
            return n;
          }
          return null;
        }

        function collect() {
          var st = { y: 0, tg: {}, sheets: [], sc: {}, cart: null, lower: {} };
          var locked = document.documentElement.classList.contains("scroll-locked");
          st.y = locked
            ? Math.abs(parseInt(document.body.style.top || "0", 10) || 0)
            : (window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0);
          document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded="true"]').forEach(function (b) { st.tg[toggleKey(b)] = 1; });
          // The three lower tabs' state is recorded explicitly,
          // both ways, so a reload restores each tab exactly as the
          // visitor left it (they start CLOSED as slim tabs in the
          // markup — see the slim tab rail addendum).
          ["supportToggle", "outcomesToggle", "classesToggle"].forEach(function (id) {
            var lb = document.getElementById(id);
            if (lb) st.lower[id] = lb.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
          });
          if (cartGet) { try { st.cart = cartGet(); } catch (e) {} }
          document.querySelectorAll(".sheet-overlay.show").forEach(function (ov) {
            var rec = { id: ov.id };
            if (ov.id === "sheet-packingmap") {
              var s = document.getElementById("pm-sub");
              if (s) rec.sub = s.textContent;
            }
            st.sheets.push(rec);
          });
          ["pm-pages", "admin-pages", "man-pages"].forEach(function (id) {
            var n = document.getElementById(id);
            if (n && n.scrollTop) st.sc[id] = n.scrollTop;
          });
          document.querySelectorAll(".sheet-overlay.show").forEach(function (ov) {
            var sh = ov.querySelector(".sheet");
            if (sh && sh.scrollTop) st.sc[ov.id + ">.sheet"] = sh.scrollTop;
          });
          var cs = document.querySelector("#sheet-curriculum .curr-sheet");
          if (cs && cs.scrollTop) st.sc["curr-sheet"] = cs.scrollTop;
          return st;
        }

        var saveTimer = null;
        function scheduleSave(ms) {
          if (restoring) return;
          if (saveTimer) clearTimeout(saveTimer);
          saveTimer = setTimeout(function () { saveTimer = null; if (!restoring) write(collect()); }, ms == null ? 200 : ms);
        }
        function saveNow() { if (!restoring) write(collect()); }
        window.addEventListener("scroll", function () { scheduleSave(150); }, { passive: true });
        document.addEventListener("scroll", function () { scheduleSave(250); }, { passive: true, capture: true });
        document.addEventListener("click", function () { scheduleSave(250); }, true);
        document.addEventListener("change", function () { scheduleSave(250); }, true);
        if (window.MutationObserver && document.body) {
          new MutationObserver(function () { scheduleSave(300); })
            .observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "hidden"], subtree: true });
        }
        window.addEventListener("pagehide", saveNow);
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () { if (document.hidden) saveNow(); });
        ["pointerdown", "touchstart", "wheel", "keydown"].forEach(function (ev) {
          window.addEventListener(ev, function () { userTouched = true; }, { passive: true, capture: true });
        });

        function scrollToY(y) {
          if (!y) return;
          var root = document.documentElement;
          var prev = root.style.scrollBehavior;
          root.style.scrollBehavior = "auto";
          window.scrollTo(0, y);
          root.style.scrollBehavior = prev;
        }
        function applyToggles(tg, inSheets, skipAsk) {
          Object.keys(tg || {}).forEach(function (key) {
            var btn = findToggle(key);
            if (!btn) return;
            if (skipAsk && btn.id === "askLauncher") return;
            var inside = !!btn.closest(".sheet-overlay");
            if (inside !== inSheets) return;
            if (btn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true") btn.click();
          });
        }
        function applyScrollers(sc) {
          Object.keys(sc || {}).forEach(function (key) {
            var n = null;
            if (key === "curr-sheet") n = document.querySelector("#sheet-curriculum .curr-sheet");
            else if (key.indexOf(">") > -1) {
              var ov = document.getElementById(key.split(">")[0]);
              if (ov) n = ov.querySelector(".sheet");
            } else n = document.getElementById(key);
            if (n) n.scrollTop = sc[key];
          });
        }

        function restore() {
          var st = read();
          if (!st || restoring) return;
          restoring = true;
          try {
            if (st.cart && cartSet) { try { cartSet(st.cart); } catch (e) {} }
            // Page-level sections (Purchase, FAQs, kit bars, hero
            // panels…). The Ask launcher is applied last so its
            // scroll lock captures the restored offset.
            var tg = st.tg || {};
            applyToggles(tg, false, true);
            // Lower cards: apply the saved state directly, both ways —
            // a card the visitor collapsed must come back collapsed,
            // not reset to its open markup default by a shell reload.
            if (st.lower) {
              Object.keys(st.lower).forEach(function (id) {
                var b = document.getElementById(id);
                if (!b) return;
                var r = document.getElementById(b.getAttribute("aria-controls") || "");
                if (!r) return;
                var open = !!st.lower[id];
                r.classList.toggle("open", open);
                b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(open));
                var sec = b.closest("section");
                if (sec) sec.classList.toggle("is-collapsed", !open);
              });
            }
            scrollToY(st.y);
            (st.sheets || []).forEach(function (rec) {
              try {
                if (SV.openSheet) {
                  if (rec.id === "sheet-packingmap" && rec.sub) {
                    var s = document.getElementById("pm-sub");
                    if (s) s.textContent = rec.sub;
                  }
                  SV.openSheet(rec.id);
                }
              } catch (e) {}
            });
            // Ask panel last (see above).
            var askBtn = document.getElementById("askLauncher");
            if (askBtn && tg["id:askLauncher"] && askBtn.getAttribute("aria-expanded") !== "true") askBtn.click();
            setTimeout(function () {
              applyToggles(tg, true, false);
              applyScrollers(st.sc);
            }, 80);
            // Lazy images settling can grow the page; re-assert the
            // offset a few times — only while nothing is open above the
            // page and the visitor hasn't started moving themselves.
            if (!st.sheets || !st.sheets.length) {
              [250, 600, 1200, 2000].forEach(function (ms) {
                setTimeout(function () {
                  if (!userTouched && !document.documentElement.classList.contains("scroll-locked")) scrollToY(st.y);
                }, ms);
              });
            }
          } catch (e) {}
          setTimeout(function () { restoring = false; saveNow(); }, 2200);
        }
        if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", restore);
        else restore();
      })();
    </script>
    <script>
      // Page scroll lock — shared by every popup on the page: the kit
      // sheets, the PDF/manual viewers, and the Ask Sourccey chat. While any of them is open, the page behind
      // must not move.
      //
      // Why not just body { overflow: hidden } (the old approach): on
      // iOS that alone leaks — a scroll inside an open popup still drags
      // the homepage with it, and the chat never locked at all.
      // The reliable lock pins the body with position:fixed at the
      // current scroll offset, then restores that offset on unlock.
      // Ref-counted, so stacked popups (a parts sheet over a kit sheet,
      // a viewer over a sheet) each hold the lock until the last
      // one closes.
      var __scrollLockCount = 0;
      var __lockedScrollY = 0;
      // Ask Sourccey launcher yield — while any sheet/overlay is open,
      // the floating launcher must fully yield (hidden + untappable) so
      // it can never overlap a control inside the open sheet, and it
      // restores exactly when the last overlay closes. State is read
      // from the DOM (scroll-lock count, hero demo/enroll collapses),
      // so every open/close path — buttons, backdrop taps,
      // Escape, stacked sheets — lands on the same answer. The one
      // exception is the launcher's own open chat panel.
      function syncAskLauncherYield() {
        var launcher = document.getElementById("askLauncher");
        if (!launcher) return;
        var askPanel = document.getElementById("askPanel");
        if (askPanel && !askPanel.hidden) {
          launcher.classList.remove("yielded");
          launcher.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
          launcher.tabIndex = 0;
          return;
        }
        var demoPanel = document.getElementById("demoPanel");
        var enrollPanel = document.getElementById("enrollPanel");
        var onlinePanel = document.getElementById("onlinePanel");
        var yieldNow =
          __scrollLockCount > 0 ||
          (demoPanel && demoPanel.classList.contains("open")) ||
          (enrollPanel && enrollPanel.classList.contains("open")) ||
          (onlinePanel && onlinePanel.classList.contains("open"));
        launcher.classList.toggle("yielded", !!yieldNow);
        if (yieldNow) { launcher.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); launcher.tabIndex = -1; }
        else { launcher.removeAttribute("aria-hidden"); launcher.tabIndex = 0; }
      }
      function lockPageScroll() {
        __scrollLockCount++;
        syncAskLauncherYield();
        if (__scrollLockCount > 1) return;
        __lockedScrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0;
        var b = document.body;
        b.style.position = "fixed";
        b.style.top = (-__lockedScrollY) + "px";
        b.style.left = "0";
        b.style.right = "0";
        b.style.width = "100%";
        b.style.overflow = "hidden";
        document.documentElement.classList.add("scroll-locked");
      }
      function unlockPageScroll() {
        if (__scrollLockCount > 0) __scrollLockCount--;
        syncAskLauncherYield();
        if (__scrollLockCount > 0) return;
        var b = document.body;
        b.style.position = "";
        b.style.top = "";
        b.style.left = "";
        b.style.right = "";
        b.style.width = "";
        b.style.overflow = "";
        document.documentElement.classList.remove("scroll-locked");
        // Restore the offset instantly — the page's smooth-scroll
        // setting would otherwise animate the return and make it look
        // like the page jumped or refreshed on its own.
        var root = document.documentElement;
        var prevBehavior = root.style.scrollBehavior;
        root.style.scrollBehavior = "auto";
        window.scrollTo(0, __lockedScrollY);
        root.style.scrollBehavior = prevBehavior;
      }
    </script>
    <script>
      (function () {
        // Video slideshow — behind the WATCH SOURCCEY BEING BUILT pill.
        // On load the section is ONLY the pill: no video element and no
        // poster frame exist anywhere on the page. The pill tap builds
        // ONE horizontal swipe slideshow (slides side by side, never
        // stacked) with visible arrow controls, expands the panel, and
        // starts slide 1 — the new reel — playing WITH sound (the pill
        // tap is the watch gesture). Tapping the pill again collapses
        // the panel and removes the slideshow entirely. Slide 1 (reel):
        // tap the video to pause, tap again to resume; no center play
        // overlay; the poster/first frame shows before any tap. Slide 2
        // is the factory film with its established behavior, unchanged:
        // whole frame (contain, no crop); the poster shows while the
        // stream loads; tap the video to pause and the center Play
        // button returns; tap Play to resume; the corner button toggles
        // mute. Swiping or arrowing to a slide pauses the film left
        // behind; nothing autoplays off-screen.
        //
        // Delivery is dual-source with automatic failover:
        //   PRIMARY  — interim direct host (pomf2.lain.la), verified
        //              before wiring with the full serving gate:
        //              Content-Type video/mp4, Accept-Ranges: bytes, and
        //              a Range request returned 206 Partial Content with
        //              Content-Range bytes 0-1023/5061173; the full
        //              download's md5 (07d9ee9852df6d15495c1ed0dbd9e04b)
        //              matches the bundled factory-video.mp4 byte-for-byte.
        //              Hosting history: the original Catbox stream
        //              (files.catbox.moe/v892r0.mp4) is dead — Catbox
        //              unreachable, HEAD and Range requests return
        //              nothing — and the next interim host, Uguu,
        //              deleted both slideshow files within hours on
        //              2026-10-21 (both URLs returned 404 that night),
        //              so pomf2.lain.la carries the factory film, same
        //              as the reel's. A Cloudflare Pages project
        //              "sourccey-media" exists as the planned permanent
        //              home (undeployed) — when it deploys, swap this
        //              primary to it.
        //   FALLBACK — the bundled copy (H.264, limited-range yuv420p).
        //              This artifact host serves bundled files as
        //              application/octet-stream without ranges, which
        //              Chromium tolerates but iPhone Safari refuses —
        //              half of the original "video doesn't play" fault
        //              (the other half was a full-range encode, since
        //              replaced with the limited-range master).
        // If the primary's play() rejects, the media element errors, or
        // no playing/timeupdate progress lands within ~4 seconds, the
        // fallback loads and plays automatically — no second tap. The
        // same failover covers a primary that stalls mid-load on later
        // taps (waiting/stalled re-arm the watchdog).
        var FV_PRIMARY = "https://pomf2.lain.la/f/z682ofl7.mp4";
        var FV_FALLBACK = "data:application/octet-stream;base64,
